The data states (radarSites, warnings, circulations, etc.) should stay as individual useState calls — only the UI control states should move. Here is exactly what to do: 1. Create a uiState reducer. Define this interface and initial state above the App function: ts interface UIState { animationEnabled: boolean radarOpacity: number animationSpeed: number showCirculations: boolean showVelocityCouplets: boolean showMotionVectors: boolean showWarnings: boolean showSpcOutlook: boolean showSiteLabels: boolean showSatellite: boolean satelliteOpacity: number showWind: boolean windOpacity: number windIntensity: number windLevel: number showVoronoi: boolean windIntensity: number } const initialUIState: UIState = { animationEnabled: false, radarOpacity: 0.7, animationSpeed: 1, showCirculations: true, showVelocityCouplets: true, showMotionVectors: true, showWarnings: true, showSpcOutlook: false, showSiteLabels: false, showSatellite: false, satelliteOpacity: 0.5, showWind: false, windOpacity: 0.7, windIntensity: 0.6, windLevel: 500, showVoronoi: false, } 2. Create a simple reducer function: ts type UIAction = { type: 'SET'; key: keyof UIState; value: UIState[keyof UIState] } function uiReducer(state: UIState, action: UIAction): UIState { return { ...state, [action.key]: action.value } } 3. Finish by updateing github with the changes **Copilot:** *(no response captured)* --- ## Turn 10 — 2026-04-01 02:06:41 UTC **User:** Task #9 — Add LRU Eviction to imageCache - In live-nexrad-weather/src/components/WeatherMap.tsx, the imageCache Map at line 74 grows unbounded — every radar frame image URL ever loaded gets cached forever, which will cause memory leaks over time as the app runs. Replace the plain Map with a simple LRU (Least Recently Used) cache limited to 120 entries. Here's exactly what to do: 1. Replace the existing imageCache declaration: ts const imageCache = new Map() with a new LRUCache class and instance: ts class LRUCache { private readonly max: number private readonly cache: Map constructor(max: number) { this.max = max this.cache = new Map() } get(key: K): V | undefined { if (!this.cache.has(key)) return undefined // Move to end (most recently used) const value = this.cache.get(key)! this.cache.delete(key) this.cache.set(key, value) return value } set(key: K, value: V): void { if (this.cache.has(key)) this.cache.delete(key) else if (this.cache.size >= this.max) { // Delete least recently used (first entry) this.cache.delete(this.cache.keys().next().value!) } this.cache.set(key, value) } has(key: K): boolean { return this.cache.has(key) } } const imageCache = new LRUCache(120) 2. The preloadImage function already uses imageCache.has(), imageCache.get(), and imageCache.set() — those call signatures are identical to the LRU implementation above, so no changes needed there. 3. Do NOT change anything else in the file. **Copilot:** ``` ``` ---
